sample_unit: clinical text cases across three benchmarks (MultiCare, OLB-300, and one other)
models_evaluated: six open LLMs (not named in text)

links.outcome: Misclassification-detection AUROC of posterior-based uncertainty versus black-box confidence baselines
links.effect: On MultiCare, misclassification-detection AUROC was 0.923 for M-SMC versus 0.760 for softmax and 0.584 for a consistency baseline.
links.quote: Across three clinical benchmarks and six open LLMs, the inferred posterior separates correct predictions from errors more sharply than black-box confidence, with misclassification-detection AUROC on MultiCare of 0.923 for M-SMC against 0.760 for softmax and 0.584 for a consistency baseline.

unlisted_practices: Bayesian posterior inference (SMC-ABC) over diagnoses using LLM as class-conditional simulator, with explicit clinician prior incorporation

screen.reason: Evaluates methods for uncertainty calibration, misclassification detection, and incorporating clinician priors to safeguard LLM clinical text classification.
